focus_areas: Structural integrity and topological boundary of the man-made path on the foreground cliff.
Geometric depth consistency of the path relative to the rock face.
Realism of water turbulence and foam patterns.
Texture consistency across different depth planes (foreground vs mid-ground).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the pathway carved into the foreground cliff. Using the bounding boxes from the detector, does the topology auditor confirm it has sharp, distinct edges, or does it bleed into the rock? Does the geometric depth auditor confirm it protrudes logically from the cliff face? Also, examine the transition between the white sea foam and the dark rock for unnatural color bleeding.
image_description: A dramatic coastal landscape featuring steep, dark rock cliffs rising vertically from a turbulent ocean. The cliffs exhibit rugged, weathered textures with visible stratification and erosion patterns. Green vegetation covers the plateau tops and clings to ledges. A narrow path or walkway is carved into the side of the foreground cliff. The water below is churning white foam against the base of the rocks.
